referenceScenarios.threat: Token tampering / privilege escalation in client-side decision logic
referenceScenarios.control: Cryptographic signature validation and server-side role check before granting admin access
referenceScenarios.residual_risk: Replay attack if token lacks expiration or nonce

referenceScenarios.threat: Brute-force credential guessing on login decision branch
referenceScenarios.control: Exponential rate limiting and lockout after 5 failed attempts

referenceScenarios.asset: User profile data in browser localStorage
referenceScenarios.threat: Cross-site scripting (XSS) injecting malicious script into DOM decision paths
referenceScenarios.control: Encrypt database backups at rest using AES-256
referenceScenarios.residual_risk: Backups stolen from cloud storage bucket
